description: Experience the iconic taste of the New England coast with this authentic Maine Lobster Roll recipe. Succulent, fresh lobster meat is lightly dressed and nestled into a perfectly toasted, buttery split-top bun, delivering a delightful balance of rich and delicate flavors. This classic American seafood sandwich is a true culinary indulgence, perfect for any special occasion or a taste of summer.

ingredients.notes: about 1.5 lbs total, or 1.5 lbs cooked lobster meat

ingredients.item: New England style split-top hot dog buns

ingredients.notes: half for juice, half for wedges

instructions.title: Prepare the Lobster Meat
instructions.text: If using live lobsters, bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Carefully add the lobsters, cover, and cook for 8-12 minutes depending on size, until bright red. Remove with tongs and plunge into an ice bath to stop cooking. Allow to cool completely.

instructions.title: Extract Lobster Meat
instructions.text: Once cooled, carefully crack and extract all the meat from the lobster tails, claws, and knuckles. Discard the shells. Cut the lobster meat into bite-sized chunks, ensuring no shell fragments remain. Place the prepared lobster meat in a medium bowl.

instructions.title: Season the Lobster
instructions.text: In the bowl with the lobster meat, add the juice of half a lemon, a pinch of salt, and a grind of fresh black pepper. For a classic Maine cold style roll, you may gently fold in 1-2 tablespoons of mayonnaise now. For a hot buttered style, skip the mayo and proceed.

instructions.title: Prepare the Buns
instructions.text: Melt 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter in a small saucepan or microwave. Lightly brush the outsides of the split-top hot dog buns with the melted butter, ensuring even coverage on both sides.

instructions.title: Toast the Buns
instructions.text: Heat a griddle or large non-stick skillet over medium-low heat. Place the buttered buns face down on the hot surface and toast until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from heat and set aside.

instructions.title: Assemble the Rolls
instructions.text: If making hot buttered rolls, melt the remaining 4 tablespoons of butter in a clean skillet. Add the seasoned lobster meat and gently warm for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, being careful not to overcook. Spoon a generous amount of lobster meat into each toasted bun.

instructions.title: Garnish and Serve
instructions.text: Garnish the finished lobster rolls with fresh chopped chives or parsley. Serve immediately with lemon wedges on the side, perhaps alongside a side of potato chips or coleslaw for a complete New England experience.

tips: For the best flavor, always use fresh, high-quality lobster. If live lobster is unavailable, frozen cooked lobster meat can be used, but thaw it properly and pat dry before preparing.

The key to a perfect Maine Lobster Roll is minimal dressing to let the natural sweetness of the lobster shine. A little butter and lemon are often all you need. If using mayonnaise, use a high-quality brand sparingly.
Always toast your buns in butter until golden and crisp. This crucial step adds texture, richness, and prevents the bun from becoming soggy, elevating the entire sandwich experience.
